title: Cozy Hearts
description: This Datapack shows hearts when you stand near a friend.
body:
# 💕 Cozy Hearts

### 🥰 This Datapack makes hearts spread when you stand near another player. That's all.

Use this in any multiplayer world, With your friends, or even with your partner!

### 🔴 Versions, find them on the [versions](https://modrinth.com/datapack/cozy-hearts/versions) page:
- Standard Edition
- Cuddling Edition, You'll need to stand closer for the hearts to appear
- Unobstrusive Edition, The hearts appear higher above your head, may look less good.

### ⁉️ I've just installed it, and it does not work!
Double-Check if you've got the datapack installed on the world itself. It must be in ...saves/(your world)/datapacks

❤️Thanks for downloading!
